buildComparisonSvg and sendFollowup do not exist. The real calls are generateComparisonCard(options) (svg comparison-card.ts:96) and sendFollowUp(applicationId, token, {file:{name,data,contentType}}) (discord-api.ts:47-75). renderSvgToPng is real.
